requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.
State updates go through scripts/project_queue.py status and note ONLY. GOV.ORCH.5 forbids hand-editing project/*.json, and this movement is not an exception.

EVIDENCE BEFORE STATUS. For each item, first gather the proof and write it down, then set the status. An item you cannot prove closed stays open -- that is a correct result, not a failure of the movement.

Evidence means a file path plus what is in it, or a command plus its output. 'It looks done' is not evidence. A contract's own status line, a class that exists with the behaviour named, a migration file, a passing test -- those are evidence.
If an item is only PARTLY satisfied, do NOT set it done. Leave the status and add a note through the tool saying exactly which part is satisfied and which is not.
Commit early and often on the lane.
Do not merge to main. The Product Owner assistant reviews the diff and merges.
Do not run the full pytest suite. It creates untracked data/ and logs/ directories that the repository privacy gate then flags, failing a movement whose diff is clean.
Touch ONLY the backlog item ids this packet names. Another movement is running in parallel on a different, disjoint set of ids in the same file; editing an id outside your set will collide with it.
